rules.name: Python dependencies should be locked to verified versions
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Top-level await should be preferred over promise chains and async wrappers
External GitHub Actions and workflows should be pinned to a commit hash
Node.js built-in modules should be imported using the "node:" protocol
Number static methods and properties should be preferred over global equivalents
Unnecessary imports should be removed
Functions should not have too many parameters
Arrays used only for existence checks should be Sets
Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
JavaScript package manager scripts should not be executed during installation
Multiple consecutive calls to methods that accept multiple arguments should be combined
Unnecessary character escapes should be removed
Exceptions should not be ignored
Unnecessary character escapes should be removed
Write permissions should be defined at the job level
Tests should include assertions
Exceptions should not be ignored
Use Object.hasOwn static method instead of hasOwnProperty
Regular expressions should not cause non-linear backtracking
Existence checks should use ".includes()" instead of ".indexOf()" or ".lastIndexOf()"
Re-exports should use "export...from" syntax
Unnecessary imports should be removed
Fields that are only assigned in the constructor should be "readonly"
Unused assignments should be removed
Assignments should not be made from within sub-expressions
OS commands should not rely on PATH resolution
OS commands should not rely on PATH resolution
Functions should not have too many parameters
String literals with escaped backslashes should use `String.raw` template literals
Ternary operators should not be nested
Built-in error objects should have meaningful messages
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Strings should use "replaceAll()" instead of "replace()" with global regex
Top-level await should be preferred over promise chains and async wrappers
Template literals should not be nested
Node.js built-in modules should be imported using the "node:" protocol
Number static methods and properties should be preferred over global equivalents
Multiple consecutive calls to methods that accept multiple arguments should be combined
Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
Type constituents of unions and intersections should not be redundant
"RegExp.exec()" should be preferred over "String.match()"
Regular expression quantifiers and character classes should be used concisely
Constructors should not contain asynchronous operations
Optional chaining should be preferred
"Array.prototype.sort()" and "Array.prototype.toSorted()" should use a compare function
Objects and classes converted or coerced to strings should define a "toString()" method
Character classes in regular expressions should not contain the same character twice
Ternary operators should not be nested
Imports from the same module should be merged
Python package manager scripts should not be executed during installation
JavaScript dependencies should be locked to verified versions
